name: Rus (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a black bend from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Rus (a black bend on yellow within an inscribed red bordure).
history: The flag of the municipality is an adaptation of its arms.
